# Serial Work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SerialWork`](gmeow-SerialWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SerialWork>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An ongoing authored work released over installments — a web serial, comic series, or magazine. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

Use [`gmeow:SerialWork`](gmeow-SerialWork.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an open-ended authored work released over installments — a web serial, comic series, magazine, or podcast at the [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a single issue, episode, or chapter (that is a [`gmeow:SerialInstallment`](gmeow-SerialInstallment.md) manifestation) and avoid it for a closed collection issued as one unit (use [`gmeow:Collection`](gmeow-Collection.md)).

### How to use

- Type the work [`gmeow:SerialWork`](gmeow-SerialWork.md), give it [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md), and hang each released installment as a [`gmeow:SerialInstallment`](gmeow-SerialInstallment.md) via the universal part spine; the in-universe narrative frame links by [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md).

### Examples

- ex:webserial a [`gmeow:SerialWork`](gmeow-SerialWork.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:serialTitle; [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md) ex:installment42.
